{{Top|leg}}
The '''Incident at Anoat''' was a collision between two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] near [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]] during the pursuit of the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' after the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] escape from [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The details of the incident became required reading at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] on [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]]. The names of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] involved were posthumously recorded at the academy.<ref name="CCG-Egregious">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Egregious Pilot Error}}</ref>
